name: le-space-belege
description: Le Space's skills for agents around Belege: wallets read by address, the bridge set up on the person's own machine, the exports read for the bookkeeping.

plugins.name: belege
plugins.description: Own wallets as ledger entries with @le-space/chains, @le-space/ledger and @le-space/rates (no key); the Belege bridge installed, paired and configured on the person's own machine (secrets only through its hidden prompts); the DATEV package and the crypto-ledger files Belege exports, read for the bookkeeping.
